data.body: Operator decision 2026-11-02 on ENV_ID_MISMATCH: option (2). fsck skips the env-id divergence check when the author is the shared bot account (shared credentials are a permanent operating constraint, AGENTS.md), so a healthy multi-clone store reports clean. Accepted consequence: a re-clone that loses its git-ignored .env-id/.opcert-key is not detected by this check for bot-account writes. Other authors keep the check. UNSIGNED_ENV (no signing identity on this host) is a separate pending decision.
